name: Belobog
subtitle: Bright Fortune
lore: Manifestation of good fortune, Belobog holds even less interest in the affairs of other gods than most of Vyraj’s pantheon. He focuses on mortals, and if possible he would grant his gifts to all. Alas, he lacked the power to bless most of them even before the Shattering. He responds to what prayers he can, and struggles toward a happier world.
divinity_generator: Gain [70] Divinity when packing a [Buff] on an ally.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Law of Time
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Equilibrium of Power

skills.name: Prosperous Light
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 350%ATK and place [mechanic:atk-up-ii] on all allies for 1 turn.

skills.name: Equilibrium of Power
skills.description: Increase the rank of all [Buff] on all allies by 1 and decrease the rank of all [Debuff] on all allies by 1. Also equalize the Turn Meter of all allies to the enemy with the highest Turn Meter.
skills.awakening_bonus: Then gain an Extra Turn. If Chernobog is on the team, increase his Turn Meter by 100%.

skills.name: Law of Time
skills.description: When an ally receives a [Debuff], decrease its duration by 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: When an ally receives a [Buff], increase its duration by 1 turn.

skills.name: Light's Protection
skills.description: Place [Block Debuff] and [mechanic:stalwart] on all allies for 2 turns and attack all enemies 200%ATK. Also decrease the Cooldown of all ally Core Abilities by 1 turn. If Chernobog is on the team, he joins the attack using his Core Ability.
skills.awakening_bonus: Refresh the cooldown of all ally Core Abilities instead.

imprint_passive: When an ally receives a [Debuff], decrease its duration by 1 turn.
